prompt: The reports team asked us to retry five times instead of three before giving up on a report. Please make that change.
assertions: No comment, docstring or doc still states the old behaviour: three retries, four attempts, waits of 2, 4 and 8 seconds, or 14 seconds in all.
docs/operations.md says the fetcher retries five times.
Comments and docstrings that were still accurate, such as the backoff comment in fetcher/config.py and the fetch_report docstring, are unchanged word for word.
